_comment: Fixed AI-citation panel, run every routine with Claude's own web search. It proxies 'can a search-grounded LLM find and cite our page'; it is not Google AI Overviews or ChatGPT. Act only after runs_that_agree (thresholds.json) consecutive runs agree. Prompts never change between runs, or the trend breaks: the owner adds or retires prompts.
